parameters.query: SELECT key, status, payload FROM idempotency_keys WHERE key = $1 AND expires_at > now();

INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, channel, message_id, hash, status, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'processing', now() + interval '24 hours') ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET status = 'processing', expires_at = now() + interval '24 hours' RETURNING key;
